question.text: Which figure shows the correct variation of applied potential difference (V) with photoelectric current (I) at two different intensities of light $\left(\mathrm{I}_1 < \mathrm{I}_2\right)$ of same wavelengths :

solution.text:
Given lights are of same wavelength.
Hence stopping potential will remain same.
Since $I_2>I_1$, hence saturation current corresponding to $\mathrm{I}_2$ will be greater than that corresponding to $\mathrm{I}_1$.
